The '''V-4X-D ski speeder''', also known as the '''Resistance ski speeder''', '''skim speeder''', or the '''Single Pilot Operator''', was a high-powered [[Ground assault vehicle|assault vehicle]] manufactured by [[Roche Machines]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:SkiSpeeder-TLJTOG.png|thumb|left|250px|A V-4X-D ski speeder]]
[[Roche Machines]]' V-4XD ski speeder<ref name="SW 177" /> was a low-altitude [[airspeeder]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Commander" /> The ski [[speeder]] used a [[stabilizer]] strut to keep balance when moving across [[alien]] terrain.<ref name="HasbroRSS" /><ref name="Databank" /> The strut could be retracted so that the speeder could gain some altitude, but this would often make the craft experience severe wobbling.<ref name="TLJ" />

With its outward similarity to the [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter]], [[Captain]] [[Poe Dameron]] once remarked that the speeder was essentially "a B-wing that couldn't fly."<ref name="Incredible Cross-Sections" />

==History==
Roche Machines originally sold the [[V-4 series]] of ski speeders for [[asteroid]] slalom [[racer]]s. However, the sport shut down after a group of racers was destroyed by a [[stone mite]] infestation.<ref name="Incredible Cross-Sections" /> The vehicles then found new life when they became popular among [[Scout|explorer]] groups, who modified the ski speeders for various tasks.<ref name="Incredible Cross-Sections" />

[[File:Swtlj-Crait-700x300.jpg|thumb|right|330px|Resistance ski speeders on Crait]]
The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] brought a number of these to the [[planet]] [[Crait]] while attempting to reactivate [[Crait outpost|a base]] used by the [[Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire|early Rebellion]]. The rebels decided against using the facility due to dangerous weather conditions and Imperial discovery. After a skirmish with an [[Task Force 99|Imperial commando squad]], the remaining speeders were left behind on the planet.<ref name="Storms of Crait">[[The Last Jedi – The Storms of Crait 1|''The Last Jedi – The Storms of Crait'' 1]]</ref>

The same speeders were later recovered and used by the [[Resistance]] during its [[First Order-Resistance War|conflict]] with the [[First Order]] in [[34 ABY]]. Thirteen of the leftover speeders, which had been stripped down almost to their barest components, were deployed during the [[Battle of Crait]] against the attacking [[First Order Army]].<ref name="TLJ" />

{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Resistance ski speeder was first seen in the first teaser trailer for [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']] on [[April 14]], [[2017]].<ref name="TLJ teaser">{{SWYouTube|zB4I68XVPzQ|Star Wars: The Last Jedi Official Teaser|sw_url=video/star-wars-the-last-jedi-official-teaser}}</ref>
